meta.title: Windows PowerShell 7 Router
meta.description: Routes DSH's pwsh tool to PowerShell 7 on Windows (or forces Windows PowerShell 5.1), always redirects Remove-Item deletions to the Recycle Bin, and provides per-user detection, system installs and upgrades through the official in-place MSI, a Web setup dialog with live download progress, a Settings page with install status, self-check, route switching, per-user uninstall and system migration, and a sandbox-aware executor.
